question:
Given is the data on the weights of some students. What is the mean weight (in Kg) of all these students taken together? 

 
 

 
 
No. of Students

 
 
 
Weights of the Students (in Kg)

 
 
 

 
 
5

 
 <td style="width:217px;
solution:
Calculation:

The mean weight of all these students taken together

⇒ (5 × 31 + 7 × 25 + 6 × 20 + 4 × 35 + 3 × 20) ÷ (5 + 7 + 6 + 4 + 3)

⇒ 650 ÷ 25

⇒ 26

**∴ The mean weight of all these students taken together is 26 kg.**
